comment: Original EarthQuaker Devices Rainbow Machine-inspired polyphonic pitch-warping approximation. The pedal's six knob controls are represented; footswitch-only behavior is not reproduced.
fxid_comment: 0x01E9. Unused by current effect manifests and tools/effects_db.json at implementation time.

params.name: Pitch
params.comment: Unison at noon, moving from a fourth below to a third above.

params.name: Primary
params.comment: Level of the primary pitch-warped harmony.

params.name: Tracking
params.comment: Controls the pitch-grain delay and tracking character.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: Dark-to-bright tone of the harmony voices.

params.name: Secondary
params.comment: Adds a second voice an octave beyond the primary harmony.

params.name: Magic
params.comment: Adds regeneration and increasing pitch-warped repeats.
